doc: docs/rescue-locator/pole-widzenia.md, section 'Wagi śladów: wiarygodność i zanik w czasie'
formula: weight = sources[source] * accuracy factor of type * 0.5^(ageH / halfLifeH) * corroboration, clamped to 0..1; halfLifeH null = no decay
note: Illustrative defaults, not TOPR/GOPR procedures. 'est' = estimate without a direct source.

trop-psa.note: trail age: 90% <3h, 70% 12h, 50% 24h, 25% 48h (3retrievers); double-blind 2026 start choice at chance level

pies-alert.note: area dog false alerts ~3.4% (0-18%); halfLife est

swiadek.note: est; distance error grows with range and delay (Lindsay 2008, Nyman 2019)

zgloszenie.note: est; unverified crowd report, dedupe reports from the same appeal

gps.note: smartphone 5-12 m under canopy (Forests 2022); halfLife est for a mobile subject, 12 h if immobile

bts.note: Cell ID rural 5-20 km (up to 30 km), TA step ~550 m (EENA); halfLife est

aml.note: EENA: <=50 m in 90%; PL full rollout planned 2027 (UKE); halfLife est

slad-buta.note: est; ages with sun and rain, mud slowest

przedmiot.note: est; shows where the person was, not where they are

dron-termo.note: unconfirmed thermal hit; tracking detector precision 90.3%, recall 73.4% (Remote Sens 2025); halfLife est

meldunek.note: est; trained searcher with team GPS

scentHalfLifeMultipliers.note: est; studies disagree on weather effects (Greatbatch 2015, Sci Rep 2024)

corroboration.note: est; agree = independent clues from different sources within radiusM and age gap <= shorter halfLife; conflict = contradicts a higher-weight clue beyond reachable distance; operator always wins
